name: Brookfield Office Properties Inc. Preferred Shares (BPO.PR.I)
summary: Brookfield Office Properties Inc. is a real estate investment firm that acquires, develops and manages commercial properties, including core-plus office buildings, and provides related services such as tenant support and amenities. Its strategy targets markets in the United States, focusing on major North American urban centers such as Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Denver, Houston and New York.
